body:
This release lets SuggestArr **send requests straight to Radarr and Sonarr**, no Seer needed. It adds **Approve all / Reject all**, shows **why the AI picked a title** in chat notifications, lets accounts **bring their own AI provider**, and includes a big round of **reliability and safety fixes**.

---

## 🎯 Radarr & Sonarr, Without Seer

- **Connections → Where requests go** lets you choose **Seer**, **Radarr & Sonarr**, or **both**
- Direct requests are added and searched right away, with the quality profile, root folder and tags you choose (anime ones optional)
- Titles Radarr or Sonarr already hold, monitored or not, are never suggested again
- Every title SuggestArr adds is tagged **suggestarr**; turn on **Also tag each title with who it was suggested for** to add `suggestarr-user-<name>`
- Existing setups stay on Seer until you change it

---

## 🔔 Everything Works in Direct Mode

- Request badges move from **requested** to **processing**, **partial** and **available** by reading Radarr and Sonarr; `request.available` and personal notifications fire as with Seer
- Rejecting a suggestion in the approval queue can bring **one alternative** from the same job; requesting the original again cancels it
- **Cleanup** deletes unfavorited titles straight in Radarr or Sonarr, files included, and **only ever titles tagged suggestarr**
- Jobs can carry their own **Radarr/Sonarr profile**, and can **pause while downloads are still in the queue**
- Only auto-decline of old pending requests still needs Seer

---

## ✅ Clear the Queue in One Click

- **Approve all** and **Reject all** act on every suggestion waiting for approval that matches your filters, not only the cards on screen
- Up to 1000 at a time, after the usual confirmation
- If a decision's answer gets lost, the queue reloads so you see what really happened

Addresses #570.

---

## 💬 Smarter Notifications & Previews

- Discord, ntfy and Telegram notifications for AI picks now say **why** the title was suggested (`data.rationale` in webhooks) (#569)
- Job **Preview** shows titles and descriptions in your display language (#568)
- Generated text in Discord notifications can't ping anyone

---

## 🤖 Your Own AI Provider

- Admins can let an account use its **own AI key, address and model** for AI Search (**Users → Edit → AI settings**, then **My AI provider** on the profile)
- Everyone else and scheduled jobs keep using the shared provider
- Personal addresses set by non-admins must be public, and multi-person searches always use the shared provider, so other people's history never reaches a provider they didn't agree to
- AI calls give up after 2 minutes instead of 10, and empty answers are retried

---

## 🛡️ Reliability & Safety

- **Seer delay works again**: `SEER_REQUEST_DELAY` spaces Seer requests so large batches don't make Seer skip notifications
- **Offline backends**: requests wait in the queue for up to **7 days** and go out once Seer, Radarr or Sonarr is back
- **Cleanup safety breaker**: a run that would delete a lot waits for an admin's OK, a failed favorites read deletes nothing, and recently watched titles are kept
- **One run per job**: Run now and Run all follow the same pauses as scheduled runs; **Run anyway** skips them once
- A movie and a show with the **same TMDb id** are both stored now
- **MySQL 8** fresh installs work again, and long text is no longer cut on MySQL/MariaDB
- Disabled or deleted accounts are signed out right away, logout really revokes the session, and the configuration is no longer stored in the browser
- Old sessions, webhook deliveries and cleanup logs are cleaned up daily at 05:00

---

## ⚠️ Before You Upgrade

- **Back up your database**: this release migrates the requests tables and widens MySQL/MariaDB columns on start-up
- Removed unused endpoints: `/api/admin/export-config` and `/api/admin/import-config` (use the Dashboard export/import), `/force_run`, `/pool-stats`, `/test-db`
- Only one process is supported; gunicorn is no longer included
- Container arguments are now passed to uvicorn after the defaults, so `--log-level debug` no longer drops host and port

---

## 🧰 Maintenance

- New What's New popup: one note per release with icon slides and a link to past releases
- Font sizes follow your browser's text size, plus keyboard and screen-reader fixes
- Removed dead code and 8 unused Python packages
- Updated openai, croniter, axios, vue-router, vite, eslint, stylelint and Playwright; added httpx

See [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md) and [docs/FEATURES.md](docs/FEATURES.md).

This release adds **one-tap rating prompts on Telegram and Discord**, **multi-person AI Search**, smarter **AI Search exclusions**, **unified feedback** and **request sorting**, plus a round of **accessibility** fixes.

---

## ⭐ Rate What You Watch

- SuggestArr can message you a while after you finish a title and ask for a rating with **1 to 10** buttons
- One tap saves the rating to **Profile → Recommendation history**, so recommendations learn from it
- Choose **Telegram** or **Discord** under **Profile → Rate what you watch**, and a delay from 0 to 48 hours (default 12)
- A movie is asked once; a show is asked once, not per episode
- Titles you already rated or excluded are never asked, and only plays after you turn the setting on count
- At most 5 prompts are sent every 15 minutes, and delivery is at most once
- Changing where prompts go disables the buttons of messages already sent

---

## 💬 Discord & Telegram Setup

- **Telegram** uses a dedicated bot and your private chat id; no public address is needed
- **Discord** uses your own bot with direct messages, and the **Interactions Endpoint URL** is shown in your Profile (sub-path included)
- Discord taps are verified with Discord's signature, so only you can answer, from your own DM
- A **Send test message** button explains why Discord refused, if it did
- Discord requires SuggestArr to be reachable over HTTPS
- ntfy and plain Discord webhooks are not supported, because they cannot carry verifiable buttons

See [docs/RATING_PROMPTS.md](docs/RATING_PROMPTS.md).

---

## 👥 Multi-Person AI Search

- A new **Searching for** row lets you pick yourself and up to three other people
- Type **@** in the search box to mention someone and select them
- With two or more people, the AI looks for titles **everyone** would enjoy and avoids anything one of them disliked
- Titles any of them watched, dismissed or marked as seen are hidden
- Only accounts with a **verified** media-server link appear, and anyone can opt out with **Allow others to include me in AI Search**
- Selected people's names and watched or rated titles are sent to your configured LLM provider

Addresses #550.

---

## 🚫 Fewer Repeated AI Search Results

- Each search now tells the AI up to **150 titles to skip**: dismissed, seen, watched, requested, in your library and, with **Exclude seen** on, shown in earlier searches
- Results are still filtered after the answer, as before
- These titles are sent to your configured LLM provider

Addresses #551.

---

## 👍 Unified Feedback

- AI Search and Requests now share the same **Good pick?** answers and the same server-side validation
- Extra answers like **Too similar** and **Save for later** sit under **More**
- An optional **Mostly because of** reason can be added once an answer is chosen

Addresses #552.

---

## ↕️ Request Sorting

- Requests can be sorted by **date**, **title** or **rating**, ascending or descending
- Unrated titles always sort last
- "For …" no longer shows raw media-user IDs when no name is known

Addresses #561.

---

## ♿ Accessibility & UI Fixes

- Page language is set, input focus is visible, and inline links are underlined
- Reduced-motion preferences stop movement while keeping fades
- The onboarding tour is now a keyboard-friendly dialog, and the job modal keeps focus inside
- Paused jobs and AI Search without a provider stay readable
- Login and API docs have proper landmarks and heading order
- The home page shows an error with retry when recent requests fail to load
- The ratings history table no longer widens the page on phones

---

## 🧰 Maintenance & Testing

- New test suites for Telegram and Discord rating prompts, multi-person AI Search and AI Search exclusions
- Expanded coverage for AI Search feedback, LLM prompts, list import sorting and watched history
- New client tests for mentions, the Discord endpoint URL, feedback options, the switch component, the tour and the job modal
- Updated openai, amqp, billiard, kombu, pytz, tzdata and docker/login-action; added PyNaCl

This release adds **original-language selection for AI Search**, improves **Jellyfin library scanning**, and fixes **AI recommendation counts** and **viewing-history isolation**.

---

## 🌐 Original Language in AI Search

- Added an **Original language** selector under **Search options**
- Choose **From prompt**, **Any language**, or a specific language for movies and TV shows
- A specific selection overrides the language requested in the prompt; **Any language** removes the prompt's language restriction
- The selection is remembered per account in the current browser
- AI Search no longer applies the legacy global job language filter
- This setting filters a title's original language; displayed text and dubbed audio are controlled separately

---

## 🛡️ AI Search History Privacy

- Fixed AI Search reading every Jellyfin user's watch history when no user IDs were provided
- By default, searches and history-based search starters now use only the current user's **verified linked media account**
- If no verified account is linked, searches still work without viewing history
- Administrators can explicitly select media-server users through the AI Search API; an empty selection uses their own verified link

Addresses #553.

---

## 🤖 AI Recommendation Counts

- Fixed AI recommendation jobs treating **Similar titles per title** as the total number of recommendations
- The setting now applies as a maximum for **each unique watched title**
- Duplicate recommendations and results assigned to an unknown source title are discarded
- The final count can be lower after filtering, and large requests may exceed an AI provider's output or context limits

Addresses #554.

---

## 📚 Jellyfin Library Improvements

- Jellyfin library scans now include individual movies inside collections when checking which titles are already owned
- Matching those movies requires TMDb provider IDs in Jellyfin
- Viewing history is fetched across libraries concurrently, with up to five library requests at a time

Addresses #555.

---

## 🧰 Maintenance & Testing

- Expanded automated coverage for AI Search language selection, viewing-history permissions, recommendation counts, and Jellyfin library and history handling
- Added a standard Jellyfin job test without Simkl integration
